newsitem.title: USA: Enron chairman says EPS estimates on target.
newsitem.headline: Enron chairman says EPS estimates on target.

text.p: Enron Corp Chairman Kenneth Lay on Tuesday said analysts' consensus estimates of $0.50 to $0.63 a share in the fourth quarter and $2.20 to $2.40 a share for 1996 were "on target."
"We'll be well on target with their estimates," Lay told Reuters.

Enron posted $0.52 a share earnings in the fourth quarter 1995 and $2.07 a year earnings for the year. The 1995 fourth quarter and year-end results included an $83.4 million pretax litigation charge and $19 million pre-tax writedown offset by a $66.7 million pre-tax gain from the sale of assets.
